'''Yurats''' (Yurak) was a [[Samoyedic languages|Samoyedic language]] spoken in the [[Siberia]]n tundra west of the [[Yenisey|Yenisei River]]. It became extinct in the early 19th century, due to the expansion of the [[Nenets|Nenets people]].<ref name=":0" /> Yurats was probably either a transitional variety connecting the [[Nenets languages|Nenets]] and [[Enets language]]s of the Samoyedic family, or an archaic dialect of Enets.<ref>{{cite book
|first=Juha
|last=Janhunen
|authorlink=Juha Janhunen
|title=Samojedischer Wortschatz
|year=1977
|page=8
|series=Castreanumin toimitteita
|volume=17
|location=Helsinki
|isbn=951-45-1161-1
|issn=0355-0141
}}</ref> While it is marginally closer to Enets rather than Nenets, it does not show a majority of either Enets or Nenets features.<ref name="salminen">{{Cite book |last=Salminen |first=Tapani |title=The Uralic languages |date=2023 |publisher=Routledge |isbn=978-1-138-65084-8 |editor-last=Abondolo |editor-first=Daniel Mario |edition=2nd |series=Routledge Language Family |location=London New York |page=103 |chapter=Demography, endangerment, and revitalization |editor-last2=Valijärvi |editor-first2=Riitta-Liisa}}</ref> Some eastern dialects of [[Tundra Nenets language|Tundra Nenets]] may have a Yurats substrate, as the Yurats were likely absorbed by the Tundra Nenets.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-02-11 |title=Endangered languages in Northeast Asia: report |url=http://www.helsinki.fi/~tasalmin/nasia_report.html#Yurats |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190211093750/http://www.helsinki.fi/~tasalmin/nasia_report.html#Yurats |archive-date=February 11, 2019 |access-date=2024-06-23 |website=[[University of Helsinki]]}}</ref> The uncertainty regarding the language's status is due to the scarcity of information about the language.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Siegl |first=Florian |url=https://www.sgr.fi/sust/sust267/sust267.pdf |title=Materials on Forest Enets, an Indigenous Language of Northern Siberia |date=2013 |publisher=Société Finno-Ougrienne |isbn=978-952-5667-46-2 |location=Helsinki |page=35 |via=Suomalais-Ugrilainen Seura}}</ref> Nevertheless, ''[[Glottolog]]'' considers it to be a dialect of [[Tundra Nenets language|Tundra Nenets]], as is the traditional assumption.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Glottolog 5.0 - Yurats |url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/yura1256 |access-date=2024-06-20 |website=glottolog.org}}</ref>
